examShortTricks: Trick 1: Symmetry tests in three lines — even: f(−x) = f(x) (mirror about y-axis); odd: f(−x) = −f(x) (rotation about origin); neither: no symmetry.
Trick 2: Periodicity: find smallest T > 0 with f(x + T) = f(x); for sin/cos T = 2π, tan T = π — check the constant term first.
Trick 3: Monotonicity from the sign of f′: f′ > 0 increasing, f′ < 0 decreasing; mark the turning points where f′ = 0 and sketch through them.
Trick 4: Always list intercepts (f(0), f(x) = 0), domain and asymptotes BEFORE drawing — the marking scheme rewards these checkpoints.
